1.9.4

Running version shown right of the month selector — and it's honest: the badge reads `APP_VERSION` from the front-end module graph and compares it with the version the server just rendered into the page shell. Match → quiet `v1.9.4`. Mismatch → an inked `v → v · RELOAD` chip, because that state means the browser is executing cached modules while the shell is current (the trap behind "I updated but nothing changed"). A build gate keeps `APP_VERSION` and the plugin version in lockstep so the tripwire can't cry wolf.

1.10.0

Sheet-header rework from Chris's markup. Months now read as JAN FEB MAR APRIL MAY JUNE JULY AUG SEPT OCT NOV DEC — in the grid's first-column header (full names overflowed its two-column span and clipped to "VEMBER") and in the month selector, so both match. Forward navigation stops one month past the current one: the next sheet stays reachable for staging habits before tracking starts, but the calendar can't wander into empty future months — the `›` arrow dims at the cap, the native month picker gets a `max`, and `changeMonth()` enforces it too so the picker can't jump the fence. The running version and the color workbench both moved into the gear menu: the palette button is gone from the tab bar (five tabs now), the workbench panel opens from "Color workbench…", and the version sits as a footer line that still flips to an inked `v → v · RELOAD` when the module graph is stale against the served shell.
